## Experiment assets

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `experiment_folder` | `str` | `napari_sbt` | `basic` | Project-relative folder containing versioned napari_sbt experiment manifests, frozen cohorts, labels, models, and reusable feature assets. | Keep this folder under the project root so managed and local runs agree. |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
